name: All Fried Up

name: Aromas
sourceUrl: https://get.cbord.com/sandiego/full/menu.php (CBORD GET ordering system — merchants "Aromas: Crepes, Toast, Bagels" and "Aromas Express: Full Menu")
crossCheckedAgainst: https://triton.news (USD student newspaper article reporting a specialty-toast price increase from $8.75 to $9.50, matching the "Aromas: Crepes, Toast, Bagels" merchant's current price)
notes: USD campus dining, ordered through get.cbord.com (CBORD 'GET' ordering system) — no public menu page, reverse-engineered by replaying the site's own AJAX calls (fetch merchant list with a cookie jar for session + formToken, POST formToken+due_time to menus.php to get an auto-selected menuId, then POST formToken+due_time+menuId to menu.php for the full server-rendered priced menu; no browser needed). Two merchants exist on the same ordering system for the same physical Aromas location: 'Aromas: Crepes, Toast, Bagels' and 'Aromas Express: Full Menu'. They list overlapping items (Toast, 4 crepes, 3 specialty toasts, 5 bagel items) at DIFFERENT prices (Express ~$0.75-1.00 higher) — a real disagreement between two first-party listings on the operator's own system, not merged. Used the smaller 'Aromas: Crepes, Toast, Bagels' merchant's prices for those overlapping items because they are externally corroborated by a dated campus-newspaper article (specialty toast reported as increased from $8.75 to $9.50, matching this merchant's $9.50); Express's prices for the same items were not used and are presumably a later, further price increase not yet reflected in the smaller merchant. All other (non-overlapping) items came only from Express and are filed at Express's price. Many espresso/tea/coffee drinks price at $0.00 base and require a required 'Size' (or similar) selection with no free option — filed at the cheapest required option's price per the from-price rule, each flagged individually in that dish's notes via the section/price combo (see per-item from-price disclosure baked into price selection above; cheapest required Size chosen, secondary optional modifiers like milk/syrup ignored).
